conservative.description: High safety margin: refuses earlier on borderline unusual inputs.

balanced.description: Recommended default: balanced trade-off between detection of true unknowns and false alarm rate.

bold.description: Permissive: minimizes false alarms on familiar crops; reserves refusal for severe anomalies.

limitations: Thresholds calibrated on synthetic unknowns (LOCO, box-uniform, column permutation). Real field sensor anomalies may differ.
Overlap between specific crops (e.g., jute vs. rice) reduces LOCO separability for those pairs.
Midpoint traps between clusters require caution handling as intermediate points may be outside single-crop density clouds.
